title: What If I'm One Hell of A Fighter
description: After his father dies, Kane is taken in by Eve, a gym owner. Bullied as a janitor, he hides his skills until gangsters threaten the gym. Months later, the gym thrives. Kane and Eve find family and purpose together.

description: The entire universe is divided into the inner universe and the outer universe. The two universes are enemies of each other. In the universe, there are countless mortal worlds like the Tianfa Continent, and they are collectively referred to as the Jiutian Xin Region. title: My Unicorn Girl [Hindi]
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

Meanwhile the nearby Ba family are a much more righteous group, with the wisdom of Granny Ba, the style and sword skills of 9th Miss Ba and the enthusiasm of son Master Ba. title: 30:e november
description: On November 30th (the date when King Karl XII died) there will usually be demonstrations by hyper-national and neo-Nazi groups, and also democratic counter demonstrations. The plot of "West Side Story" is transferred to the Stockholmian suburb Alby where many immigrants live. But the film is no plagiarism, in particular no so because many scenes have the intensive character of live transmission. The boy (Adam) belongs to a Nazi group whose racial attitude is foremost directed against immigrants with 'wrong' colour of hair or skin. The girl (Julia) belongs to a family of political fugitives from Peru. Adam and Julia immediately fall in great and reciprocal love, and there are highly emotional love scenes. Therefore Adam breaks with his group. But when his best friend is killed by Julia's brother, he kills the brother. In turn the couple is hunted by the police and Julia's relatives. title: Mesquite Outlaws F.C. Game
description: The first game kicks off at 7:30am and the second at 10am. The 10am game will be broadcast on the Mesquite Outlaws Twitch channel. Be sure to tune in. all Games will be produced by Lou Productions, US, and broadcast over twitch. Check out Team and League Websites for schedule information. The Draft took place in the ballroom of the Statler Hotel in Dallas, Tex. on Sunday, October 23. Each of the League's 14 teams had an opportunity to scout talent at the Pro Player Combine held in Mesquite, Tex. over the three days prior. Players came from as far as France and Australia and as close as Dallas to showcase their talents and hopefully land a roster position on one of the League's teams. The draft consisted of three rounds with team's having a pick in each. Teams also had the opportunity to trade or sell their picks. "It feels great, it's everything I could have asked for, I worked hard to get here," said Gomez. "I'm grateful for the opportunity, all the coaches, the MASL and the Commissioner, who gave me a lot of tips and motivated me throughout the whole process."The day we've all been waiting for is finally here. The talent and intensity have picked up with every new game and today's contests should be an exceptional display. If the combine were a regular season today would be the championship game and the vibe in the hotel is fitting. The players were once again reshuffled into four rosters.

title: Swag G Style
description: Swag G Style follows the lives of six gay/bisexual men in Dallas, Texas. We explore their friendships, business lives and how they cope day to day with the stigma of being gay and black in America. G Style Swagg is a reality series that allows the viewer a inside look at the hearts of 6 friends dealing the complications of life from coming out or not, and how it affects their day to day dealings in love, friendships, family and business. The intent of the show is to build a bridge of tolerance between the gay and straight communities.

title: H: Murmur
description: Serial killer Shin-Hyun gives himself up to police and confesses to committing a series of particularly horrifying murders of exclusively female victims. He is imprisoned and awaiting the death sentence but the killings continue, with the same characteristics of the Shin-Hyun serial killings. The case is re-opened when two more bodies are discovered, both pregnant women; one found in the city's landfill site and the other was horrifically murdered on a public bus. Detective Mi Yun (Yum Jung-Ah) and her newly-appointed partner Detective Kang (Ji Jin-Hee) are assigned to the case. Mi Yun and Kang have difficulty working with each other; their personalities and working methods constantly clash. Detective Kang goes about his new job buoyantly and enthusiastically. He follows a new suspect, Huh, and eventually catches him in the act of brutally murdering a woman in a crowded techno bar. Huh is taken into custody after Kang shoots and wounds him at the crime scene. Once again, the case seems to be solved with this spectacular arrest--yet the murders continue in copy-cat style. The police desperately hunt for new leads. They start an in-depth investigation of a Doctor Chu, who is Shin-Hyun's psychiatrist, but progress is frustrated when Dr Chu becomes a victim of the copy-cat killings herself. The murdered psychiatrist's former boyfriend, a fanatical character named Choi, quickly becomes the prime suspect. All the pieces are finally starting to fit together, and the case seems almost resolved. But all efforts are suddenly frustrated once again, when Choi takes his own life--but still, the killings continue. The case gets more complicated when even the police themselves appear to become suspects in the murders. In unraveling this mystery, everyone involved is pushed to the limits of human understanding.

description: Told from the perspective of a former scientist turned wandering telepathic man-child, I Razor is the story of one man's quest to regain his lost humanity. Gregory Fleer, a young scientist who has developed a new brain-altering substance called I Razor, is transformed by his own experiment and must negotiate his way through a world twisted beyond recognition by his altered perceptions. The film begins with Dr. Fleer already transformed, and teamed with his equally afflicted companion The Professor, who possesses certain inexplicable magic powers. Together, the Sergeant and Professor experience visions, perform music, and take a dark journey through a world populated by a tribe of fellow "freaks" and their leader, the phantasmagoric Mother Skinny, along with her right hand subhuman creation, The Homunculus. When the Professor abandons the Sergeant, the Sergeant finds some solace in the natural world, but his yearning to reclaim what he believes to be his lost identity unwittingly draws him back into the fray of society, where a struggle between good and evil awaits him.

title: Crazy With a K
description: "Crazy With a K" ...is a semi-autobiographical web-series that unabashedly calls depression a disease. Creator, Joël René Scoville knows that no one likes to watch people go through depression, so she lets us laugh at her, cry with her, and experience her fight against the odds as she combats this illness. We follow JOEY through a few select moments in her life following her second divorce from the same guy. Her depression haunts her, but her friends and group therapy companions try to be there for her as she tries to figure out how to move on with her life while dealing with a failed suicide attempt and trying to remain somewhat constant for her three adult children.

title: Her Private Life [Hindi]
description: Follows a talented gallery curator named Sung Duk Mi, who is an idol fan-girl underneath her professional veneer. Meanwhile, her boss Ryan becomes a passionate fan-boy of her.

title: F#@K I Love U
description: F#@k I Love U is a dramatic tale of a modern family that gets quickly pulled into a spiral of interconnected events that test the limits of their bond and mutual love. Douglas Winston is, by all appearances, the perfect family man. A well groomed and successful black politician, he, his wife white Angie, and their two sons, James and Michael, seem to lead idyllic lives that quickly begin to unravel when Douglas visits his brother J, an white irresponsible would be actor with heavy drug and sex habits. After a jeopardizing incident endangers all of their lives, Douglas is quick to blame J and his irresponsible nature, but in trying to delve into the actual truth, the strands that hold his life together quickly start to unravel into a downward spiral of twisted connections, tangled love, and intrigue that will put to the test the true limits of his faith in those he loves and who he believes in.

title: Twisted Tie
description: When a torrential downpour blocks his way home after work, rookie employee Seon U ends up spending the night at the apartment of Team Leader Kang, the boss he has always found intimidating. Seeing the normally cold, perfectionist Team Leader Kang at home without his glasses and completely off guard, Seon U feels an unexpected flutter of attraction. Later, while sharing wine after a shower, Kang's surprisingly teasing and provocative side emerges, pushing Seon U to finally give in to the rebellious feelings he had long kept suppressed. As the two begin a tense and secret office romance, the arrival of Assistant Manager Baek from a client company throws everything into a new phase. Holding the absolute weapon of a business contract between the companies, Baek pushes Team Leader Kang's jealousy and desire for control to their limits. Thus begins a tangled and dangerous story involving three men, where love, rivalry, power, and possessiveness become increasingly intertwined.

They decide, at a dance party, to go for it all. Forget the Pro-Am; they want to try for the title that Jake felt he never deserved. title: O Klearhos, i Marina & o Kontos
O Parto Que Destruiu o Chefão
description: Grávida de nove meses, Alessia é mantida em cativeiro pelo próprio marido, Vito Falcone, que a obriga a adiar o parto para garantir que o filho da viúva de seu irmão nasça primeiro e herde o território da família. Ignorando seus apelos e colocando a vida da esposa e do bebê em risco, Vito escolhe proteger a outra mulher. Quando finalmente decide libertá-la, já é tarde demais: Alessia e o filho desapareceram, deixando-o diante das consequências irreversíveis de sua traição.

title: O Sakaflias
description: 1935. Giorgos Sakaflias has the reputation of the toughest man of Trikala. He loves the beautiful but poor Lenio, while the rich Nora wants him. Nakas, who wants Lenio his own, will blame Sakaflias for the murder of Smyrnia's prostitute. Nora, too, when she does not succumb to her appetites, will blame him for rape. Sakaflias will leave from Trikala. The police will ring him and start looking for him.

title: O Grão
description: The elderly Perpétua, feeling the approach of death, decides to prepare Zeca, her beloved grandson, to the inevitable. She tells him the story of a king and a queen, a wealthy and powerful couple who lost their only child but wishes to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Damião e Josefa work hard to support their family and to prepare their daughter Fátima's wedding. At the end, the tale told by Perpétua and the destiny of that family will cross.

title: O Desejado
description: João is the spiritual heir (the term he prefers to bastard) of Manuel Brandão, his dying godfather, and at the same time the political leader of a small party of a disintegrating governmental coalition.

title: O Liberdade
description: The documentary talk about a magic place, the heart of the bohemian in Pelotas, southern Brazil. The Samba, Choro, and all the popular culture.

title: O... Çocuklari
description: Turkey is under the yoke of the military regime. Unbelievable events will develop in the axis of the house of the custodian mother, who takes care of the children of prostitutes.

title: O-Negative
description: A doctor forces his daughter's boyfriend to help him find and kill unsuspecting victims in search of that one with O-Negative blood that will save the daughters life.

title: O Fascínio
description: O FASCÍNIO is an intriguing story about a family and a manor house (where some terrible crimes were committed in the past by a member of that family) adapted from a novel with the same title by Tabajara Ruas.

title: O tetraperatos
description: A vibrant cafe owner struggles to attract the girl of his dreams. Who knows, with a bit of luck and sharp wits, life can sometimes be a bed of roses.

title: Ter o Céu, Pagar o Inferno
description: Kíria, a Imortal do Kirin, recebeu um favor do Senhor Lima. Em troca, deu-lhe uma joia do desejo. Anos depois, o filho dele, Henrique usou a joia para pedir um filho. Kíria transformou-a numa Pérola da Concepção e, com seu poder, fez Helena, a mulher dele, engravidar de um menino. Henrique venerava Kíria, mas Helena, pensando que ela era uma filha ilegítima do marido, virou-se contra ela.

title: O papatrehas
description: With six sisters on the verge of marriage, a desperate spinster aunt, and an entire block of flats depending on him, an indefatigable concierge is making plans for the future; however, he must first find suitable husbands for his siblings.

title: Henry O!
description: Spanish-language color commentator for the Tampa Bay Devil Ray's Enrique "Henry" Oliu does the impossible - he calls a game he's never seen.

title: O Lobisomem
description: A millionaire lives in a sinister cottage where strange events unfold. A damned creature, he transforms himself in a werewolf and leads a following whose adepts spread horror and despair in the neighboring city, becoming themselves a clan of assassins. One day, the werewolf confronts Branca Justiça (White Justice), who summons benign forces to scathe them and frees him of his own wickedness.

title: O Magnata
description: In São Paulo, the upper middle class punk-singer Andre a.k.a. Magnata spends his time in the periphery with his friends from the lower class, singing in clubs and wasting his inheritance. When he is challenged by his friends to steal a Ferrari from a store, he accepts the challenge and he goes with his pal Chivitz. They rob the car and after driving for fun, Magnata goes to the stage for a concert and asks Chivitz to get rid off the car because it would be located through the GPS system. However, Chivitz decides to drive more and is arrested by the police. Meanwhile, Magnata meets Adriana Melo, who has just arrived from New York, with his friend Renata that invites him for her birthday party on the next day. Magnata dates Adriana and falls in love for her, but this reckless prank stealing the Ferrari leads them to a tragic consequence.

title: O Touro
description: A Portuguese girl arrives at the Lencois Island, in Brazil, curious about this new place surrounded by huge white sand dunes. Its residents are all descendants of King Don Sebastian, who disappeared in the 16th Century.

title: O pappous mou o Papaflessas
description: A tender look at the hero of the Greek Revolution of 1821. Papaflessas traveled to Constantinople in the age of enlightenment and romanticism, and became a member of the revolutionary organization "Filiki Eteria" (Society of Friends), taking on the task of inciting his compatriots against the Ottoman Empire. What sets the heroes apart? Can their mistakes be justified?

title: P.S. I Love You [Hindi]
description: A young widow discovers that her late husband has left her 10 messages intended to help ease her pain and start a new life.

title: Ang bilis naman! Papu, 'dumamoves' kay Nelds
description:
Minsan, life imitates fiction, 'ika nga. Ang mga eksenang akala mo sa pelikula lang nakikita, pwede rin palang mangyari in real life. Kung nakaranas ka na ng mala-romcom scene sa totoong buhay, eh di ikaw na, siguradong makaka-relate ka sa bagong harana ng P-Pop group VXON. Bukod sa kuwento tungkol sa kanilang bagong awitin, may bitbit din silang pa-kilig sa mga fans as they celebrate their 4th anniversary!

Hindi pa man nagsisimula ang games sa Laro laro Pick, ang mga lola't lolo na players, muntik nang magbardagulan sa pag-aagawan ng puwesto. Vice Ganda to the rescue!

Nakuha naman ni Nelds ang atensyon ng mga tao sa studio dahil sa mga kuwento niyang walang preno. At ano itong chika na nagkayayaan na sila ni Papu na mag-date? Sa kanilang kulitan, may nasabi si Nelds na tiyak iyong ikagugulantang, kaya si Meme, napahingi na lang ng paumanhin sa MTRCB.

Laugh trip din ang mga eksena nang si Vice Ganda'y mamalikmata. Napagkamalan si Papu na isang personalidad na umano'y "nagtatago," o para ring "roll on na nagpapawis." Kinilala rin nila si Beth, na nagtuturo sa mga batang may ADHD. Teka, nanggigil si Meme! Bakit kasi ang dami niyang kapareho ng OOTD?!

But the luckiest of them all ay si Loi! Mahirap man ang buhay, positibo pa rin ang panananaw ni nanay. And with that positivity, tama lang na sugalan ang POT question baka sakaling masungkit nag P200k POT money.

Sa pagbubukas ng panibagong yugto sa Ika-10 Taon ng 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan,' matutunghayan naman natin ang talento ng mga taga-Region 5.

Hinarana ni Isaiah ang Madlang People sa studio, singing "Binibini" by Zack Tabudlo. Nabilangan man ng "isa" ni hurado Jonathan Manalo, hindi siya nawalan ng confidence sa entablado.

Ang 18-year-old contender na si Paulene, mahusay mag-majorette. Pero ang panalo sa TNT, hindi niya na-get! Na-gong ang mang-aawit sa hudyat ni Punong Hurado Bituin Escalante, na naniniwalang na-pressure ang kalahok na pretty. Sabi nga ni hurado Jonathan, "do not second-guess yourself."

Relate si Darren Espanto sa rejection na na-experience ni Paulene, kaya napa-reminisce siya about his "The Voice Kids" era, at in-encourage si Paulene na sumubok muli.

title: Bigyan ng P150k 'yan! Tatay Wil, nasagot ang POT question!
description:
Kilig-kiligan ang kantahan sa “It’ Showtime” dahil isang mapusong harana ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, Christian Tibayan, Yannie Basical, at JM Dela Cerna. Bumisita rin sina “PBB Gen 11” alums Jarren Garcia at Dingdong Bahan para sa maghatid ng good news sa kanilang fans.

Ang mga sagot ng kandidata, siguradong pag-uusapan dahil sa Miss Q and A, intense na naman ang talakan. Bagay sa korona ang pangalan ng mga kandidatang sina Kylie Prinsesa at Princess Vajar. Pero si Candidate #3 na naiiba, Noriel Rodriguez Nabing, feeling daw niya siya ang wicked stepsister.

Itinaas ng mga ‘accla’ ang kanilang bandera as they proudly shared na malaya nilang nagagawa ang mga bagay na limitado sa mga ‘beki’ noon. Ang isang simpleng halimbawa na nabanggit ni Vice Ganda, ang mga beki raw noon ay expected na matutunan ang larong basketball, na kilala bilang sports na panlalaki. Pero ang mga beki ngayon, nakakapili na ng sports na gusto nila. Kaya na-open up ni Meme Vice ang 'unsettled grief' ng mga bakla noon.

Lighthearted kuwentuhan din ang pinagsaluhan ng mga Miss Q and A at "It's Showtime" hosts nang mabanggit ng isang kandidata ang lovelife niya. Binalikan ng "It's Showtime" family ang kanilang mga first love at old-school ways para magpapansin kay crush.

Pwede nang mangarap dahil may kulay at saya ang buhay para sa mga taga-Maricaban, Pasay. Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, lumaban sila nang sabay-sabay. Pero sa challenges, hindi pwedeng sumablay.

Aliw naman ang aktingan sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric. Si Ion Perez, minulto ni Emilio Daez? At heto pa ang mas matinding plot twist, si Ogie Alcasid humingi ng kiss kay Vhong Navarro!

Ang player na nagtagumpay sa mga challenges hanggang dulo ay walang iba kundi si Marlon. Dahil gusto ni Vice Ganda na madagdagan ang pera ni Marlon, binigyan niya ito ng pagkakataon na sagutin ang POT question.

title: The Remarkable Tale of Phineas P. Gage
Jhong at Sarina, sanib-pwersa sa pag-SAMPLE
description:
Bugtong-bugtong, may korona ang hari, may kandila ang cake. Birthday ng Sample King kaya ang buong "It's Showtime" stage ay na-shake. Kasama ang unica hija na si Sarina, ipinagdiwang ni Jhong Hilario ang kaarawan niya.

Bago magsimula ang Miss Q and A segment, it's time para sa inaabangan din na kumustahan at chikahan ng trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario. Mula sa puksaan ng kasuotan hanggang sa asaran ng edad, lahat na 'ata napag-usapan ng magkakaibigan.

Samantala, mga dalubhasa sa pagtalak sina Miss Q&A candidates Dhey Pascual Abital, Beshie, at Erwina Tirambulo. Kung sa nakaraang episode ay nagpakilala ang mga kandidata at hosts with their love status, ngayon naman ay pabonggahan sila ng intro borrowing the acronyms of executive agencies sa Pilipinas.

DOJ, as in Diretso ang Opinyon, Jaw-dropping ang perfromances ng mga kandidata sa pagsagot sa pageant questions. Sina Dhey at Beshie ang umabante sa Wit Lang round.

Bumoses si Dhey tungkol sa pagbabayad ng buwis at epekto ng korapsyon as she answered the question, "Kung kinain ka na ng sistema, may nakuha ba silang sustansya?" It's better to give than to receive naman ang talak ni Beshie sa tanong na, "Kung binabalot ka ng kalungkutan pwede ka bang iregalo?"

Hindi 'to kuwentong barbero. Totoong nag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga masisipag na barberong swabe ang dating. Time out muna sa paggamit ng gunting, sa pagsayaw at pagsagot muna nila ipapakita ang galing.

Enjoy ang hosts sa kuwentuhan kay Jun, ang loving hubby at daddy, na pangarap mapagpatapos ang anak sa kolehiyo. Dahil sa pangarap ni Jun, nakaramdamn ng lungkot si Vice Ganda. Naisip niyang sa Pilipinas, itinuturing na "pangarap" ang diploma, pero kung tutuusin ito ay "basic need na dapat naibibigay sa lahat ng mga bata.

Give na give ang players sa mga challenges sa game arena, hanggang sa may isang natira, si John. May pabaon na swerte ang kanyang buntis na misis. Nakapag-uwi si John ng P40,000 matapos tanggapin ang offer. Nanghinayang nga lang si John dahil alam niya ang sagot sa POT question. Kaya dinagdagan ni Vice ng P10,000 ang papremyo ng barbero.

title: Miss Q&A Nadimunyo Lustre
description:
Positive lang ang vibes sa August 11 episode ng "It's Showtime" dahil birthday ng nag-iisang Sample King, Jhong Hilario. At ang wish niya ay hindi lang para sa sarili kundi for everybody. Eyyy!

As colorful as the rainbow rin ang kilig na bumuhos sa studio dahil sa performance ng isa sa mga paborito nating musical duos—JM Dela Cerna at Marielle Montellano, na may bagong anthem perfect para sa mga naghahanap ng lambing, titled "Perfect Together."

Kung ito ay isang color palette, bright ang bawat shade na hatid ng Miss Q and A candidates. Meet Heaven Jumawan, na head-turner ang beauty. Comedy naman ang forte ng comedy bar performer na si Senyora Acero Kabakal. Ibang 'amats' din ang baon ni Nadimunyo Lustre, na asset ang out-of-this-world na mga ngiti.

Maya-maya pa, nagsimula na ang unang round, Tumpak Ganern, kung saan unang nakasagot si Heaven. At ang nakalaban ni Heaven sa Wit Lang? Eh, 'di si Nadimunyo!

Pinalakpakan ang talak ni Heaven sa tanong na, "Sino ang mas gusto mong nag-a-update sayo—jowa mo o NDRRMC?" Pero panggulat ang naging chukchak ni Nadimunyo sa tanong na, "Anong pipiliin mo—otsenta anyos ka na pero wala kang jowa, o may jowang otsenta anyos?"

Ang mga players of the day sa Laro Laro Pick, sanay sa industriya ng hospitality. Maging warm din kaya ang welcome sa kanila ng swerte? Makilaro muna kasama ang mga receptionists ng Makati.

Panalo agad sa tawanan ang kuwentuhan nina Vice Ganda at player Chinn, ang receptionist ng Glowingly Yours salon. Nataranta naman si Neo dahil sa hotel na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan, may dumating na dalawang artista. Ano ang ggawin niya kapag nag-check in sina Ogie Alcasid at Vice Ganda?

Pagkataos ng tatlong rounds ng masayang laro, si Rovie ang umabot hanggang dulo. Hindi na pinahaba pa ni Vice Ganda ang tawaran, dahil desidido si Rovie—kahit anong mangyari, POT ay kanyang susugalan!

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Loud ang cheers at concert feels sa June 16 episode ng "It's Showtime," as Ryan Bang performed some of the best OPM hits sa isang masayang birthdayprod, na nagpaindak sa mga manonood.

Araw-araw ay parang grand celebration ng mga 'beki' na hatid ay good vibes. Sa Day 2 ng pinakabagong season ng "Miss Q and A," muling umulan ng tawanan kasama ang sangkabaklaan.

Nagpasiklaban sina Contestant 1 Michelle Calamity, Contestant 2 Kelly Agustin, at Contestant 3 Linda Walker. Kung si Vice Ganda ang kahulma ni Michelle, si Jhong Hilario naman daw ang kamukha ni Contestant 2. At kung fairytale ang kuwento for today’s video, si Kelly ang prinsesang napapaligiran ng wicked stepsisters.

Sa unang round, ligwak si Contestant 1, pero pangako niya, she will return better and fiercer than ever. Sa pabonggahan naman ng wit sa ikalawang round, full of confidence ang pagsagot ni Linda, at pak na pak ang opinyon ni Kelly. Proving that she's got both beauty and brains, nasungkit ni Kelly ang bilib ng judges na sina Karylle, Ralph de Leon at Nicole Cordoves. Si Kelly ang itinanghal na Reyna Talak-Era of the day!

Palaki nang palaki ang papremyo sa game arena, kaya naman ganado sa Laro Laro Pick ang mga senior citizens ng Tandang Sora.

Agaw-eksena ang rakistang si Bro, na um-skip muna sa isang mahalagang pag-uwi sa probinsya para makapaglaro sa studio. Si Vice Ganda naman ang maintenance nina Lola Nene at Edith dahil makita lang siya, sapat na para sumaya!

Dahil ginalingan at kinapitan ang swerte, sa jackpot round, si Tatay Roger ang umabante. Pagpapataya ng 'ending' ang kanyang pinagkakakitaan. Katulad ng hanapbuhay ni tatay, kailangan sumugal para makuha ang jackpot money na P200,000.

Siguradong may isang lolo na happy dahil si tatay Roger ay may maiuuwing P30k, matapos tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q and A
description:
Here to brighten your day, bumisita si Iñigo Pascual para haranahin tayo sa kanta niyang "Ikaw At Ikaw." Ikaw na, Iñigo! Ikaw na ang kakasa sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance challenge!

Ang mga Miss Q and A ladies, nag-transform from kandidata to comedians real quick! Nagharapan sa talakan sina Iya Zaga Arkanghel ng Laguna, Miss Mia ng Bulacan, at Toni Fowler ng Cavite.

Pinalakpakan ang kanilang galawan at confidence sa rampahan. Ang ‘amats’ nilang tatlo, hindi kayang itago! Pati si Vice Ganda ay naloka sa sagot ng mga kandidata. Kelan pa nging ‘fishda’ ang ingles ng bangus? Nawindang din si Meme sa dilim ng kili-kili ni Toni! Maya-maya pa, sina Iya at Miss Mia ang umabante sa Round 2. Sino ang mas aangat sa talakan?

Salamat sa kanilang sipag, napapanatiling malinis ang ating paligid. Kaya naman deserve nila ang bumida sa 'Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sila ang mga madlang utility workers.

Sa kuwento ni Berto, parang may nag-awoo! Bilang utility worker sa isang ospital, sanay na siya sa mga paramdam, hindi ng ex na nang-ghost, kundi ng mga kakaibang 'nilalang' na paikot-ikot, patakbo-takbo sa ospital na kanyang pinagtatrabahuan.

Kung tumaas ang 'yong balahibo sa kwento ni Berto, tataas naman panigurado ang level of happiness mo sa magulong aktingan sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round. Parang pelikula na kumpleto ang casting, sanib-pwersa sa pag-Act-Song ang paborito nating quadro—Vice Ganda, Anne Curtis, Vhong Navarro at Jhong Hilario.

Ang mommy of walo na si Riz ang umabante sa final stage ng laro. Swerte nga ba ang numerong otso? Nag-goodbye si Nanay Riz sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000, para sugalan ang P25,000 POT question.

title: Miss Q&A 3rd Weekly Finals
description:
Matutuloy na ang pagkikita ng dalawang icons ng noontime at komedya, 'Meme' Vice Ganda at 'Bossing' Vic Sotto. Samantala, mga Miss Q and A weekly finalists ang ka-date mo, at siguradong ma-i-in love ka sa mga talak nilang spot-on at matatalino. Unang tapak pa lang sa entablado, agad agad ay ready to slay and give their best sina Bb. Talinghaga, Rhain Boyonon, Mama Dhel, Jers Sabado, Raux Araneta, at Agua Gonzales.

Nasubok ang kaalaman ng ladies sa mga tanong na may kinalaman sa mga sangay ng gobyerno. Sina Mama Dhel at Rhaine ang 'chumukchak' sa final round, kung saan hinarap nila ang tanong na, "Sinong mas matalino? Ikaw o AI?"

Matalino ang sagot ni Rhain, na itinanghal na Miss Q&A TalakiTalk of the week!

Ang kabataan na masipag at may pangarap sa buhay, siguradong magtatagumpay. Mga estudyang kumukuha ng vocational courses, sumugal sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Enjoy ang kuwentuhan with Dagul, na ipinagmamalaki ang skills sa carpentry. Isinabuhay naman ni Dominick ang salitang versatility dahil sa dami ng talent na entry.

Pinaghandaan naman ng It's Showtime hosts act-song entries nila sa You Gotta Lyric round. May moment ang DaCkie tandem nina Darren Espanto at Jackie Gonzaga. At sina at MC at Lassy, bagay rin ba na maging mag-jowa?

Pito ang naka-survive sa It's Giving, pero isa lang ang nakapasa sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay si Ced. Pangarap niya, magkaroon ng malaking ambag sa pamilya. At ito na nga 'yun! Naniniwala siyang malaking ambag na ang P20,000 kaya tinanggap ni Ced ang nasabing Li-Pot offer.

title: Barbie Bratz Ayuda nag-WALK OUT sa Miss Q&A?!
description:
Nagbabalik to birit si ‘Tawag Ng Tanghalan’ champion Lyka Estrella, na tanghaling tapat pa lang ay kasintaas na ng sikat ng araw ang boses. Move, give way dahil ready na to slay sina Lucky Collins, Barbie Bratz Ayuda, at Eysi Vigo sa Resbakulawan wildcard round ng Miss and A.

Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang round kung saan nasubok agad ang kanilag talino at creativity. Ang Top 2 na sina Lucky at Barbie ay muling nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang talak sa tanong na, "Okay lang ba sa'yo kapag jinowa ng best friend mo ang ex mo?" Magkaiba ang saloobin nina Lucky at Barbie, ngunit parehong may punto.

Sa dulo, si Barbie ang mas nanlamon sa entablado at wagi sa unang Resbakulawan, matapos makakuha ng score na 9.7 mula kina Max Collins, Ralph de Leon, at Yllana Aduana.

Heto pa ang isang pagbabalik. Ang kinagiliwan noon na 'Showtime' kid na si Yorme, napadaan to celebrate his birthday habang nanonood ng It's Showtime. At kahit saglit lang nasilayan, instant throwback feels at good vibes ang hatid niya sa sambayanan.

Samantala, kapag may emergency, sila ang umaaksyon at nagbubuwis ng buhay. Ngayong Lunes, energy nila ay rumaragasa sa game arena. Sila ag mga Madlang Rescuers na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Pagkatapos ng mga eksenang nakakakiliti sa Act-Song round na You Gotta Lyric, si Chie lang ang naka-survive kaya siya ang umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P300,000 POT question na, "Anong pangalan ng galaxy ang kinabibilangan ng ating solar system?" Ang tamang sagot ay Milky Way!

title: Vice, nawindang sa Miss Q&A! Nanawagan sa DepEd!
description:
Salubungin ang July with champion biritan kasama nina TNT Duets 2 champs Christian Tbayan at Arvery Lagoring. Nagkaisa naman ang mga 'accla' sa Miss Q and A segment. Ang kanilang chika, bawasan ang problema at dagdagan ang saya. Ipinanalo nina Pia Cayetatayno, Mama Dhel, at Samaya Jhay ang protesta kontra bad vibes.

Isa-isang inilatag ng mga kandidata ang mga paandar nilang intro, drawing laughter from the Madlang People in the studio. Si Vice Ganda, may napansin sa tatlong kandidata. Kung si Pia ay may mga matang ala Meryll Soriano, si Mama Dhel naman daw ay mukhang 'baby' na 36 years overdue.

Nang magsimula ang unang round, ang nasabi na lang ni Meme ay, "Diyos ko!" dahil sa sagot ng mga kandidata for today's video. Sa tanong na, "Ano ang plural ng salitang furniture?" sumagot ang isang kandidata, na para bang sure na sure, "Super furnitures."

Kaya si Meme, 'nanginig' at nag-react nang pabiro, "Nananawagan talaga kami sa Department of Education. Gumalaw na tayo."

Sina Mama Dhel at Samaya Jhay ang nagharap sa ikalawang round, Wit Lang. Ang pinusuan ng mga hurado ay si Mama Dhel bilang Miss Q and A Reyna TalakEra sa araw na 'to.

Pumuti man ang kanilang buhok, nananatili namang makulay ang sense of humor ng mga beloved lolo't lola from Meycauayan, Bulacan na nakisaya sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Mga 'veterans' as in veterans sa pagpapatawa naman ang nagsama-sama sa You Gotta Lyric round na bagong inaabangan ng "It's Showtime" fans. Madlang People ay napa-wow nang si Vice Ganda ay lumabas bilang MemeRimar! Aww!

Ang happy ending sa kuwentong 'to ay para kay Tatay Philip, na umabante sa dulo ng laro. Positive lang ang pananaw ni tatay sa buhay. Aniya, pumunta siya sa "It's Showtime" nang walang dala, kaya aalis siyang sapat na ang P30,000 na Li-Pot offer.

#JulyNaShowtime
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Come on in, We're Dead
description: The true story of the The Young Brothers Massacre, 1932. The record for the most lawmen shot dead in the history of the United States. 10 cops and one civilian in Springfield, Missouri went to arrest 2 small-time gangsters known as The Young Brothers. The young men (Harry, 25 and Jennings, 30) had been on the run for the murder of a town marshall 3 years earlier. The Sheriff, Marcell Hendrix, had been neighbors with the fugitive?s family and late father in particular, so he didn't expect any trouble. As a consequence, they showed up at the family farm with nothing but the six-guns on their belts, and little to no additional ammo, In spite of the fact that the boys were well known for their marksmanship. The farm was on a large open piece of land with a scattering of trees around the farmhouse. When the Sheriff and his deputy pushed in the door, a massacre ensued, The officers would become trapped behind those trees, as the brothers systematically picked off the officers from the cover of the dark farmhouse.

description: An eccentric and brilliant scientist, with a £400 straw hat, attempts to create a robot that can fall in love whilst struggling to become a father for the first time.

title: Soup R Hood Heroes
description: The Soup R Hood Heroes are the heart and salvation of Park West. Tasked with keeping Mayor Vitto Mazzarelli and his flunkies from terrorizing the city the Soup R Hood Heroes are ready to protect and serve.

title: R U the Girl?
description: Tionne 'T-Boz' Watkins and Rozonda 'Chilli' Thomas embark on a journey to discover one lucky girl with the vocal talent to not only perform at the finale with them but also to record in the studio.

title: K-I-S-S-I-N-G
description: It is a coming of age, queer, Rom-Com about making out, growing up, and everything in between. We follow RUTHIE through puberty and young adulthood as seen through her first seven kisses.

title: S. O. S. - Spasite nase duse
description: The plot of this film can be viewed from a two different levels. The first is universal and deals with the psychological theme of need for competition in the group, highlighting the need for the victory, which in life usually does not depend on the true virtues of the winner, so the result is usually tragicomic. The story talks about the choice of the most noble work. Selected participants arrive at the guest house on the border between Croatia and Serbia to prepare for the final act of the competition and the jury's decision. Seven competitors have a rather narrow view of the world. Even when the big events, such as ethnic conflicts in this part of the Balkans, the contestants insist to proceed the competition and to choose the hero of heroes, even though the very idea of competition has become anachronistic under the pressure of current events (the anger of the local Serbian population of the newly established Croatian authorities).

title: Love, Lust or Run
description: Takes people's freaky style and turns it into something that expresses themselves and the job they want or have.

title: I''s Pure [English]

description: A deadly meteor strike on a planet in the distant galaxies brings destruction and the desperate escape of a young extraterrestrial in a space pod - and is forever separated from her mother and father. On earth, a young girl, Kara, finding alienation in her school and home life, wanders to a nearby lake in dejection only to come across an unexpected friend, whom she names 'Dot-t' - a mysterious new arrival on planet Earth. But others, some with dark intent, are also looking for this exceptional creature while a media frenzy breaks about proof of life on other planets. Hiding Dot-t and staying just one step ahead of pursuers - some well-meaning, some driven by greed, becomes Kara's sole mission. Fleeing deep into a forest she is helped by a seemingly sinister woodsman, himself estranged from his family. This story of flight, hiding and escape is woven around the unique love of a young girl for a vulnerable new visitor to Earth, who soon proves to be more of a friend than anyone else on her home planet. Through the soft touch of a tentacle, Dot-t reaches out to revive our natural responses of tenderness and care. And perhaps draw closer, those who matter the most to us.

title: Vjerujem u andjele
description: The mailman, Sime, is one of the favorite people of a small town, on an island in the middle of the sea. Sime is very intelligent and the locals have high regards for him because he is unusually well versed in all the events and destinies in the small town. He knows the weather forecast, what winds will blow, what the sermon on the Sunday mass will be. For all the locals Sime is an untouchable genius. However, unlike the locals, the viewers soon find out that the Sime's ingenuity is based on his reading of the mail. Fascinated by other people's destinies, Sime has perfected a way for opening letters and keeping complete records on the people living on the island. He keeps a precise track of who gets what kinds of letters, and that gives him insight into discrete and private affairs of people. One day a beautiful woman named Dea moves into town, and all the men try and court her. However, Dea is keeping some kind of a secret and she completely ignores all their attempts, also charming attempts by the mailman Sime. Suddenly, by chain of events, she completely by accident finds out about the mailman's "hobby" i.e. that he reads other people's mails. At that time she herself starts receiving letters from a mysterious Klara who she starts an intensive correspondence with. The mailman, naturally, reads Dea's mails and he's putting the "puzzle" of her life together. He plans a courtship based on the things he finds out about her. He likes Dea very much so he gives his best to win her over (naturally, he does it by using privileged information he acquires by reading her letters). After a short time Dea "falls" for his charms and everything seems idyllic. However with time, town's people turn against Sime claiming that Dea "stole him away". Sime is not concerned about it because the more time he spends with Dea the more he likes her. However what is Dea really like?

title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V [English]
description: Thanks to the Leo Corporation, headed by Reiji Akaba, new advancements to Solid Vision, the holographic system that gives life to the Duel Monsters card game, give physical mass to monsters and environments, allowing players to interact directly with them. This has given birth to challenging Action Duels, in which duelists may traverse environments to locate Action Cards to help them in a pinch. The story follows Yuya Sakaki, a second year middle school student at Maiami City's You Show Duel School, whose father disappeared three years ago when he was scheduled for an important duel. While facing off against the current Action Duel champion, Yuya awakens a new power from his pendant, known as Pendulum Summoning.

Manal, Zaki and Mounir are in there twenties, living in a confined community where basic needs are met yet chaos and disorder brew. This story reflects a football and play-station youth and how they deal with their emotions in a community that is increasingly closed off and isolated.

title: Secuestro y muerte
description: In 1970 in Buenos Aires, Argentina, former dictator Pedro Aramburu is kidnapped and interrogated by the newly born terrorist organization Montoneros.

title: María y yo
description: María lives with her mother May, in the Canary Islands, 3,000 km from Barcelona, where Miguel Gallardo has his home. Sometimes Miguel and María go on holiday together, spending a week at a resort in southern Gran Canaria, a rather unusual setting where the guests don't normally include a single father and his fourteen year-old autistic daughter. This is the story of one of their journeys, but above all it's an original tale, full of humor, irony and sincerity, about how to live with a disability.

title: Zona Y
description: A young generation of students struggle between friends, family, college and dreams.

title: Pares y Nones
description: Three teens, one city, and endless partying. Joel, Olga, and Tavo, are searching for their place in the world caught between love, loss, and teenage angst. One night when they decide to break into an empty house destiny will take over and decide their real place in the world, if it can accommodate them.

title: Y: Marshals [Hindi] S1-S2
description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves Yellowstone Ranch to join U.S. Marshals, using his cowboy and military skills to fight crime in Montana while dealing with family ties and the mental toll of law enforcement.

title: Verdades y Mentiras
description: A drama about Maria whose fantasy takes into the surreal world of Cybersex, but the one night when she tries to make fantasy into reality danger lurks.

title: Ángeles y querubines
description: A tragic celestial western that explores a surrealist point of view of the lost paradise by Adam and Eve.

title: Trampas y caretas
description: Carmen Mackenna is a multimillionaire and obsessive mother who only wants to see her two children, now in their thirties, married and stable. For this, she will use all the tricks at her hand, which in this case took the form of an attractive woman, Mariana, to whom she entrusts the job of making them fall in love and taking the one she loves the most to the altar, in exchange for a generous monthly check.

title: Amor y pecado
description: Una bebita abandonada es recogida por una familia pobre compuesta por una madre sacrificada, el marido borrachín y dos niños, Manuel y Raúl. Los muchachos son el sostén de la casa. Ya grandes, los dos hermanos se enamoran de la joven, pero ella quiere a Raúl y ambos se comprometen. Al enterarse de esto, Manuel se dedica a la bebida y a las drogas.

title: Pelucas y Rokanrol
description: Dino, a rocker, hair stylist and pedicurist gets entangled with Gina, a police sergeant in the popular neighborhood of Chapinero in Bogotá. His closest friends embark on a quest to help him and sometimes hinder his purpose of getting close to her. The music of the city of Bogotá at the time, accompanies their adventure and the visual noise of Chapinero becomes their peculiar background.

title: Cañas y barro
description: Tonet lives an intense love story with Neleta, whom he has known since childhood, but the young man will be forced to leave the Albufera of Valencia and serve in the war in Cuba. During his absence, Neleta marries the rich innkeeper Canyamel. Upon the return of the war, Tonet and Neleta cannot avoid their adulterous relationship, provoking the talk of the people of the village.

title: Azul y Blanco
description: Belonging to "brave bars" enemies in the exciting world of football, two fugitive lovers challenge everything.

title: Gregorio y su ángel
description: An alcoholic janitor is fired from his job at an orphanage, and is befriended by an angel in the guise of a little girl, who proceeds to change his life.

title: The Adventures of Y
description: When the government finds out Big Boss is back in town and stealing garbage cans, they send in the only man right for the job, Y. Which begs the question why him? He's a bumbling middle aged idiot who still lives with his mom; but somehow gets the job done. The Adventures of Y is a silly throw back to the old comedies of yester-year, with a live action cartoon feel.

title: Scott y Milá
description: After many years of life and cameras, overcoming a personal blip, Mercedes Milá is reborn on television. As never before, without filters and with laughter, brave and committed. At her side, her faithful and cheerful dog, Scott.

title: Vigilantes y ladrones
description: The search for a hidden treasure in a hotel basement.

title: Propios y extraños
description: Happiness is not getting what you want but wanting what you have.

title: X&Y [Kannada]
description: A celestial being descends to Earth on a mission to unite his destined parents, but mortal existence tests his resolve to be born.

title: Juan y Eva
description: The story is based on the first meeting of Juan Perón and Eva Duarte, during a fund-raising for the recent 1944 San Juan earthquake, and their growing relation.

title: Z-Listers
description: A passionless Z-list celebrity gets in trouble with the BBC due to copyright infringement and becomes financially unstable.

title: Generation Z
description: A web series following 5 diverse teens whose lives begin to intersect when they end up in a therapy/support group. We see their journeys in the program, the situations that landed them there, and their daily lives as teens in Generation Z.

title: Lara com Z
description: The attempts of a middle-aged actress of bringing back her stardom.

title: Dimension Z
description: When the zombie apocalypse arrives, groups of survivors band together to defend themselves at any cost. Unfortunately for the remaining few, zombies have evolved into different species altogether and exist not just in this dimension but in a dimension of their own. With little hope, the humans gather strength for one last chance at saving their world in this intensely twisted anthology.

title: Gen Z [Hindi]
description: The story of Ren Xinzheng, a professor at the University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, who is committed to promoting traditional Chinese medicine and resigns to establish a traditional Chinese medicine inheritance class, hoping to cultivate successors who can truly inherit the teachings of traditional Chinese medicine.

Although from a wealthy background, he is estranged from his father and detests him for having a mistress. By chance, Yixin bumps into them and her fashion expertise comes into handy. A love triangle inevitably forms.

title: Rangraliyan 1
description: Rangraliyan 1

In a Copenhagen suburb the 19-year-old Per is found unconscious after having been badly beaten up. He is taken to hospital in a coma. The police have no clues, but the air is thick with suspicion. His mother struggles to maintain her faith in his survival. His younger sister, Mie, begins to pick up rumors. title: Posbus 1

title: Dream
description: Years ago, journalist Shen Yueshui documented the lives of workers at the old Lacheng Brewery. Now, she returns to Lacheng, picking up her camera again to explore those corners forgotten by time. Cao Jun, Tu Chunyan, Qian Yichuan and Cheng Youtian were once the protagonists of her lens, yet their fates have been shaped by the passage of time. Their stories are like riddles sealed by time, and Shen Yueshui travels between the past and the present, uncovering these long-forgotten tales.

title: Raksha Bandhan [Hindi]
description: Lala Kedarnath, the eldest and only brother of 4 sisters, runs a chaat shop that was started by his father. Lala promises his frail mother on her deathbed that he will get married only after he fulfills the responsibility of marrying his sisters into suitable homes first. What follows is Lala's relentless efforts of getting his sisters married while upholding his family values. At the same time, Lala also faces hiccups on the personal front, his romantic life with his childhood love Sapna. However, Lala's commitment to his sisters stands as a huge roadblock for his and Sapna's love story to take off. Aside from NCERT books, there might be new versions of textbooks released by your school or educational board. These are updated to include any changes or improvements in the curriculum.

To practice Hindi, worksheets are quite helpful. You can find these worksheets online or in educational workbooks. They provide exercises and activities to reinforce what you've learned in class.

When looking for specific lessons or chapters, like Lesson 1 or Chapter 1, it's usually an introduction to the subject. Each lesson or chapter builds upon the previous one, gradually increasing in complexity.

"Hindi Kakku" sounds like a specific topic or lesson within the Hindi curriculum. You'll likely find it covered in your Class 3 Hindi textbook or supplementary materials.

If you're interested in exploring beyond Class 3 materials, you might want to check out Chapter 3 of the Class 4 Hindi textbook. This could provide additional learning opportunities or insights into the language.

For those following the CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education) curriculum, specific chapter references help locate materials aligned with the syllabus. This ensures that students cover the required topics and concepts.

Overall, whether you're accessing physical textbooks or digital resources, these materials are designed to support your learning and mastery of Hindi at the Class 3 level.

title: Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone
description:
Do you want to speak better English? This course will help you reach that goal. Speak English Professionally: In person, Online and On the Phone will boost your English speaking skills. In this 5 week course, you will learn how to identify and make a strong personal introduction. You will develop and demonstrate the speaking skills for group discussions: how to agree or disagree, how to clarify, restate and summarize. You will review and practice how to give information and respond to requests on the phone. You will study and role play effective interviewing. You will prepare and give a sales “pitch”, introducing a product or service. Throughout the course, you will adjust how you speak English and you will become more fluent and accurate when you speak. You will demonstrate culturally appropriate body language and tone. As you work through the course, you will complete self- and peer-evaluations. Through a combination of lectures, comprehension and vocabulary quizzes, practice and performance, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to communicate well in English, anywhere in the world.	
By the end of this course you will:
• Change how you speak English
•	Improve your pronunciation and fluency 
• Increase your English vocabulary 
•	Identify how culture influences your speech
•	Use culture to help you speak correctly 
•	Demonstrate the best body language for different cultural settings
•	Know statements, questions and responses for different settings and situations

title: Introduction to HTML, CSS, & JavaScript
description:
Want to take the first steps to become a Web Developer? This course will help you discover the languages, frameworks, and tools you will need to create interactive and engaging websites right from the beginning. 
You’ll begin by understanding the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack developers and how they collaborate, along with the terminology and skills essential for a web development career. 
Next, you’ll dive deep into HTML5—learning about structural elements like section, article, header, footer, and form controls such as input, fieldset, and legend. You’ll also explore the Document Object Model (DOM), scripting basics, and browser compatibility. 
Moving on to CSS, you’ll learn how to style and format web pages using selectors, IDs, and classes. You’ll explore layout tools like Flexbox and gain hands-on experience with responsive design using frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap. In JavaScript, you'll learn about variables, control structures, functions, prototypes, and how to interact with the DOM, along with practical experience using APIs and client-side scripting techniques to enhance user interaction. 
By learning the fundamentals of HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript, you will be able to combine them to: 
 - Create the basic structure of a website 
 - Create format and layout for web applications 
 - Enhance your website and create rich, interactive applications 
 - Increase user interactivity and enhance user experience 
 - Give your website a real wow factor! 
Throughout the course, you'll apply your learning through numerous hands-on labs and conclude with a final project where you'll build a webpage to showcase your skills and strengthen your portfolio.

title: Scratch in Hindi
description:
आज की दुनिया में कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग की समझ एक महत्वपूर्ण कौशल बन गयी है. कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग, जिसको कोडिंग भी कहते हैं, नियोजनीयता बढ़ाने में भी साकारत्मक भूमिका निभाती है। कंप्यूटर प्रोग्रामिंग करने से logical thinking भी विकसित होती है. 

कुछ वर्षों पहले, अमेरिका की MIT यूनिवर्सिटी के MIT Media Lab ने बच्चों में कोडिंग की रूचि जागृत करने के लिए Scratch नाम की एक फ्री सॉफ्टवेयर बनाई थी. Scratch अब बहुत प्रचलित हो गयी है और करोड़ों बच्चे, अध्यापक और अभिभावक आज Scratch के users हैं. 

Scratch में बहुत सरल block-based programming के ज़रिये आप मस्त games, animation और interactive stories इत्यादि बना सकते हैं. Scratch के नए version 3.0 में कई नए advanced features भी हैं जैसे Artificial Intelligence. 

इस वीडियो श्रृंखला में आप सीखेंगे free software Scratch में प्रोग्रामिंग.

title: Reunited Worlds [Hindi]
description: Sung Hae Sung (Yeo Jin Goo, Circle: Two Worlds Connected) is a cheery high school student. Being the eldest sibling, he wants to provide for his family instead of going to college. On the day of his 19th birthday, he gets into a car accident and passes out. He wakes up on the top of his school building. He thinks he survived and everything is normal. Except everyone thinks he died 12 years ago, and he hasn't aged at all. Jung Jung Won (Lee Yeon Hee, The Package) is Hae Sung's best friend. She was the one who took him to the place where he had his accident. Distraught, she has been unable to move on from the incident since. Having failed to pursue her dreams under the stress, she works as a kitchen assistant at a nice restaurant. Cha Min Joon (Ahn Jae Hyun, Cinderella and Four Knights) is the owner of the restaurant where Jung Won works. He has feelings for her. However, she has never shown any interest in him. In her mind, she can't be with anyone while carrying Hae Sung in her memories. One night, Jung Won finds a young man passed out in front of her house. He is Hae Sung, her first love. She is now 31; he is 19. Can they pick up their love where they left off, or will their reunited worlds always stay separate? Also known as "Into the World Again" and "Into the New World," Reunited Worlds is directed by Baek Soo Chan and written by Lee Hee Myung, the creative team behind Beautiful Gong Shim and Sensory Couple.

title: Crystal's Greatest Creation
description:
This story is a compelling exploration of hidden identities, love, and self-worth set against the backdrop of wealth and ambition. It challenges the idea of whether love can survive without truth and equality. The narrative follows two individuals who reject their powerful identities, only to rediscover themselves through each other.
Blending romance, drama, and high-stakes business conflict, the show presents a layered world of deception, family politics, and emotional transformation. At its core, it is a story of a woman’s journey from being an unseen force behind success to owning her power unapologetically.
With themes of betrayal, reinvention, and partnership, the show balances mass appeal with a modern, aspirational tone.

title: JUJUTSU KAISEN [Hindi]
description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

🧡 ■ "eFootball™" - An Evolution from "PES"
It's an all-new era of digital soccer: "PES" has now evolved into "eFootball™"! And now you can experience the next generation of soccer gaming with "eFootball™"!

■ Welcoming Newcomers
After downloading, you can learn the basic controls of the game via a step-by-step tutorial that includes practical demonstrations! Complete them all, and receive Lionel Messi!

[Ways of Playing]
■ Build Your Very Own Dream Team
You have a plethora of teams that can be chosen as your Base Team, including European and South American powerhouses, J.League and national teams!

■ Sign Players
After creating your team, it's time to get some signings in! From current superstars to soccer legends, sign players and take your team to new heights!

・ Special Player List
Here you can sign special players such as standouts from actual fixtures, players from featured leagues, and legends of the game!

・ Standard Player List
Here you can handpick and sign your favorite players. You can also use the Sort and Filter functions to narrow your search.

■ Playing Matches
Once you have built a team with your favorite players, it's time to take them to the field.
From testing your skills against the AI, to competing for ranking in Online Matches, enjoy eFootball™ the way you like!

・ Sharpen your skills in VS AI Matches
There are a variety of Events that coincide with the real-world soccer calendar, including a "Starter" Event for those just starting out, as well as Events where you can play against teams from high-profile leagues. Build a Dream Team that fits the Events' themes and take part!

・ Put your strength to the test in User Matches
Enjoy real-time competition with the Division-based "eFootball™ League" and a wide variety of weekly Events. Can you take your Dream Team to the pinnacle of Division 1?

・ Max 3 vs 3 matches with friends
Use the Friend Match feature to play against your friends. Show them the true colors of your well-developed team!
Cooperative matches up to 3 vs 3 are also available. Get together with your friends and enjoy some heated soccer action!

■ Player Development
Depending on Player Types, signed players can be further developed.
Level up your players by having them play in matches and by using in-game items, then utilize the acquired Progression Points to develop them to match your playing style.

[For More Fun]
■ Weekly Live Updates
Data from real matches being played around the world is collated on a weekly basis and implemented in-game through the Live Update feature to create a more authentic experience. These updates affect various aspects of the game, including player Condition Ratings and team rosters.

title: A Flecha e a Farda
description: The documentary begins with the 2012 discovery of silent registers of members of the GRIN (Rural Indigenous Guard) parading in uniform in 1970. It proceeds as an investigation into this all-indigenous militia group, founded and trained by Brazil's most recent military dictatorship, whose ranks were never formally dissolved. From study of archival material and present-day meetings with former GRIN members and their families unfolds a bifurcated reflection on the legacy of the dictatorship and the place of indigenous people in Brazilian society, one in which past and present hold equal weight.

title: A+
description: Alex Fellar is a bright and articulate--yet impoverished--college student. But fate intervenes, when Alex realizes the key to financial freedom lies simply in doing the work that nobody has time to do--writing term papers.

title: A Bridge to a Border
description: When a man crosses a bridge, he faces a border. Pakal Gomez, ex- border patrol officer, railroaded into prison for a crime he did not commit, turns to terror as the last chance to wake up America. A gripping character study of rebels with and without a cause...

title: A Sense of a Maze
description: In this allegorical documentary we exercise a search for answers to life's unpronounced questions in the labyrinth of a medieval medina. The milestones of the quest are existential, scientific, religious and artistic expressions. Here colors, sounds, figures and authentic musical threads lead the wanderer. The verbal, as well as the visual and sonic guidance concerns eternal truth-seeking, fear, foreignness, the sacredness of life, the discovery of "otherness", the loss of the garden of Eden, inside and outside, work and worship, ecstasy and pacification.

title: A House Without a Home
description: A marriage hits trouble when the husband loses his job while his wife achieves career success.

title: The New Americans: Gaming a Revolution
description: "THE NEW AMERICANS: Gaming a Revolution" is a visceral, meme-driven journey into the intersection of finance, media, and extremism to look at the explosive and irreversible ramifications of our digital future.

title: The B-Team
description: The B-Team is a fast-paced contemporary comedy set in the loving, chaotic, warm and neurotic world of a tight-knit Belfast family, the Buchanans.

title: Urlau(b)
description: For a long time, the village of Urlau at the foot of the Allgäu Alps was only known for its ammunition arsenal. Cäcilia Angerer still remembers the looming catastrophe during World War II. But lately Urlau has been sprucing itself up because a huge resort is about to be built where toxic warfare ammunition was once stored. Christian Skrodzki has been planning a community project to give an old factory building in the village a new purpose. The Wehr family has been preparing their vacation apartment for rent. Things are going well for the region, but suddenly it is proclaimed: "Stay home!"

title: Laila B.
description: Since surviving a physical assault on the steps of her South Boston apartment, Laila Bataglia (30) has been keeping a low profile. She spends her days hiding behind her social media persona and struggles to make ends meet as a freelance writer and part-time bartender at The Clock Tower, where she works with her ever-supportive best friend, Patrice. When a young woman turns up dead in her neighborhood, Laila is forced to face her fears again, revealing that her real fight is far from over. Inspired by true events and melding narrative with cinema verite, LAILA B. is writer, director, actor Amy DePaola's meditation on reclaiming one's power in an uncontrollable modern world.

title: Lady B.
description: Venice, July 1909. A boy from south of Italy, just rejected from the Naval Academy because of thoracic insufficiency and a slight squint, unexpectedly rescues a British pretty widow's life, Lady B. The two are joined only by a hopeless vitality and an unconsciousness desire. The lady will decide to spend with that boy a whole week of passion in which she'll teach him everything about dancing and seducing. That boy will become, in few years, the greatest mute film icon: Rudolph Valentino.

title: Plan B

title: Side B

title: R&B Divas
description: Each has had their ups and each have had their downs -- all in the harsh light of stardom. Faith Evans, Nicci Gilbert, Monifah Carter, Syleena Johnson and KeKe Wyatt -- five strong women who have been broken down and are rebuilding from the ground up. R&B Divas takes you inside the lives of these music stars as they work, play and struggle to get their lives and careers back on track. Brought together by their friendship and love of R&B goddess Whitney Houston, these incredible singers are dealing with everything from divorce to drugs and sexuality.

title: Rebirth
description: During the Battle at the Frozen Lake, both Zhuge Yue and Chu Qiao fell into the icy waters. Chu Qiao was rescued by Yan Xun, only to learn that Zhuge Yue had perished; she subsequently sought an opportunity to assassinate Yan Xun to avenge Zhuge Yue. While in Bian Tang, Chu Qiao received repeated assistance from a mysterious man, someone who felt strangely familiar, leading her to suspect that Zhuge Yue might still be alive. Meanwhile, Yan Xun's actions grew increasingly extreme, plunging the four kingdoms into chaos. Ultimately, will Chu Qiao be able to restore peace to the realm, guide Yan Xun back from his misguided path, and reuniting with Zhuge Yue, help secure a better homeland for the people?

title: C/O Sir
description: Jayabrata Ray, a teacher of a reputed school in Kurseong, finds himself in a helpless situation after losing his eyesight. Although the school authorities allow him to continue with his job for a while, but all hell breaks loose when he starts getting threat calls from the management asking him to vacate his property that is situated right inside the school premises. Jayabrata, who had also been a student of the same school, could see through their real intention and simply refuses to budge.

title: World War C
description: It's war. War against an invisible enemy that is not as deadly as we are told. The world is changing rapidly. Disproportionate measures are taken worldwide that disrupt society as a whole. A dichotomy in society forced vaccinations and restrictions on freedom. Have we had the worst? Or is there something more disturbing to awaiting us.

title: As Beautiful as You
description: Chronicles the ups and downs of Ji Xing as she navigates being an entrepreneur and falling in and out of love.

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

description: Zhou Xiaofeng, Fang Xiaoran, and Lin Yi, three cardiologists, met by chance at the Heart Center of Dongli Hospital. title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: Princess Silver
description: Rong Le, a princess of the royal family of the Xiqi Kingdom who wakes up one day to find that she has lost her memory. She is ordered to marry Zong Zheng Wu You, seventh prince of the neighboring Beilin Kingdom, though her husband-to-be refuses to let her inside his manor. Unable to return home, Rong Le settles down in Beilin and opens a teahouse under the alias of Manyao. It is rumored that the Qin family has misplaced an extraordinary tome that will supposedly usher in a time of prosperity for all the kingdoms, and Manyao embarks on a journey to find the book. Manyao and Wu You meet and fall in love without realizing each other's true identity, though they are forced to separate when Rong Le's brother Rong Qi orders her to marry the powerful General Fu Chou.

title: P over D
description: Six years of single parenthood and a betrayal from the baby father, Ailla (Salma Mumin) turned her mind to being an independent woman aided by her best friend Ursula (Ruth Kadiri) who set a business meeting for her with some business moguls (Toosweet Annan and Peter Ritchie) Met by Theon, a flirt mate of Jesse (Dcryme) who worked with her in the office and who had vowed to have her either by heart or pant. Ailla on the other hand fell in love with Theon, who was on a bet with his friends that he would bed Ailla at all cost. Theon later realized that, it was not just sex he wanted but love. Ailla is faced with the decision to stay or not to stay with Theon whom she found out is a big time player who betrayed Cassandra, another lady (Fella Makafui) just like she was betrayed. What happens when Ailla finds out that the dirty skeleton of Theon in his closet is as ugly as hers which she run's away from everyday.

title: Niya vs Sin-D
description: Niya and Sin-D exchange armwork and go-behinds as the two grapple for position and advantage in this evenly matched bout. Sin-D finally escapes and ensnares Niya in a Hammerlock, but soon finds herself trapped in a grinding Side Headlock. Sin-D takes the momentum with an eye rake, then tosses Niya into the turnbuckles and delivers numerous shoulder blocks to Niya’s back in the corner. Niya battles back with a knee to the gut, followed by a Headbutt, but Sin-D stops her in her tracks with a Chinbreaker. The two struggle for supremacy on the mat, where one wrestler locks on a bodyscissors, then adds a Sleeperhold to put her foe out cold on the canvas for a hard-fought victory.

title: E-Team
description: When atrocities are committed in countries held hostage by ruthless dictators, Human Rights Watch sends in the E-Team (Emergencies Team), a collection of fiercely intelligent individuals hired to document war crimes and report them to the rest of the world. Within this volatile climate, filmmakers Ross Kauffman and Katy Chevigny take us to the frontline in Syria and Libya, where shrapnel, bullet holes, and unmarked graves provide mounting evidence of coordinated attacks conducted by Bashar al-Assad and the now-deceased Muammar Gaddafi. The crimes are rampant, random, and often undocumented, making E-Team's effort to get information out of the country and into the hands of media outlets and criminal courts all the more necessary.

description: Robert Adanto's The F Word explores radical "4th wave" feminist performance through interviews with a new generation of feminist artists who use their bodies as subject matter. Because the female body continues to be politicized and policed, and because these artists delve into the fecund territory of female sexuality, self-objectification, and the female form as a site of resistance, many remain marginalized by the mainstream art world. Brooklyn-based Leah Schrager, well known for her performance practice, Naked Therapy, states, "As soon as you introduce a bit of sexiness or sexuality into an artwork it suddenly becomes questionable. Just because something elicits arousal or shows elements of sexiness does absolutely not make it not art." While some 4th wave artists, like Ann Hirsch and Kate Durbin, choose to analyze representations of female identity through digital media, others, like the radical, queer, transnational feminist art collective, Go! Push Pops, explore sexuality and gender in pop culture in the digital age. As feminist lecturer Kristen Sollee explains, 4th wavers, unlike their predecessors, "are not afraid to be 'girly', (or) to be hyper-feminine, or to wear a mini-skirt, to self-objectify" in the service of challenging patriarchal oppression or sexist ideals. Dr. Kathy Battista, Director of Contemporary Art at Sotheby's Institute of Art, New York and author of Re-negotiating the Body: Feminist Artists in 1970s London (IB Tauris, 2012), is an on-screen expert, as are noted art critic and curator, Nancy Princenthal, and feminist lecturer, Kristen Sollee.

title: I Think I Do
description: The relationship between three sisters, as one is left at the altar on her wedding day.

title: I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream
description: It's 109 years after the near annihilation of humanity. Just four men and one woman remain, and they have one final battle - with a psychotic computer.

title: I Lay Where I Fall
description: I Lay Where I Fall is an intimate portrait of an artist in search of his voice and a window into the raw process of making music. Follow Juston Stens across America as he collaborates with a variety of musicians on songs for his first solo album.

title: I Remember When I Die
description: If the human concept of time ceases at the moment of death, is it then physically possible to experience eternity? Can we affect this last moment in life? Can we build our own eternity? 'I Remember When I Die' takes partly place at life's last destination, a hospice - and is partly shot in a land of memories and provocative choices. We meet the patients, their stand-ins and their dreams. Death is a process. Not black and white. If you could hold on to a memory forever, which one would it be? A highly original journey into the mystery of consciousness.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. This is the motto of the Yoo family: the father is a successful doctor, the mother supervises their daughter's scholastic performance from the vantage point of their beautiful home. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

title: I fichissimi
description: Mechanic Romeo and grocery deliverer Felice lead two rival gangs and the local discotheque is not big enough for the both of them. When Romeo falls for Felice's sister, conveniently called Giulietta, the entire town becomes too small for the two rivals. Romeo is adamant to keep on seeing Giulietta while keeping clear of Felice, while Felice is forcing other suitors onto his sister that are more to his liking.

title: I, Chinese
description: An influencer famous for his racist Chinese impressions faces consequences when his family gets involved.

title: Log Horizon [Hindi] S1-S2
description: Elder Tale is an online fantasy RPG that has become popular worldwide. But when its twelfth expansion package, "Novasphere Pioneers" is installed, thirty thousand players in Japan are trapped inside. Among them is grad student Shiroe, who isn't very good at interacting with others. But to survive in a world full of monsters, he forms a guild called "Log Horizon" with an eclectic group of other players.

title: Welcome to the J: Inside Army Jungle School
description: As tensions with China build and the US military sends more troops to the Asia-Pacific region, soldiers with the skills to fight and survive in the jungle are increasingly vital. The US Army trains soldiers for jungle warfare at the 25th Infantry Division's Lightning Academy on the island of Oahu in Hawaii. Insider's chief video correspondent Graham Flanagan spent 12 days inside the Army's Jungle Operations Training Course, where a cross section of soldiers of various ranks and experience levels learn to fight, move, and survive in the jungle. Eighty students begin the course on day one, but only 51 will make it to graduation. The rest are dropped from the course by failing one of five critical tests. On day nine, students begin a three-day culminating exercise that incorporates the skills and lessons taught in the course, such as rope systems, rappelling, survival skills, small-unit tactics, and land navigation. Students who graduate from the course receive the Army's coveted jungle tab.

title: K Chyornomu moryu
description: Pretty Irina Kruchinina learns her first year at a pedagogical university. The teacher of the same institute, Konstantin Aleksandrovich, is not indifferent to her and suggests to go in the summer together to the Black Sea on the new "Volga".

title: K.
description: A documentary about a less privileged boy whom at a young age started reaching out to street children who are less fortunate like him.

title: Chelovek K
description: The main character, which is a prototype of Kafka, is on his way to achieving true self-cognition. The impetus for this was vague childhood memories associated with emotions, as well as the identification of his identity with certain images at that period. He is facing an internal conflict, tearing him apart, between creativity and reality that are not compatible with each other.

title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
description: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

title: Opus K
description: A freelance journalist is hired by a psychiatrist to investigate the death of a patient, but as the case progresses he fears he is being groomed to replace the dead man. Or worse: join him.

title: Dickie K.
description: 1980s NYC: Reagan says "Just say no," Koch asks "How am I doin'?", and a drug addict in his twenties is confronted with two choices: dying by the monkey sitting on his shoulder or accepting the help of his family and a new chance to reach his full potential.

title: Anna K
description: Anna Karenina is a socialite and wife of the soon-to-be governor of St. Petersburg, who enters a life-changing love affair with Vronsky, the dashing heir of an aluminum empire.

title: The Big 'K'
description: A movie on the British coal-miners' strike of 1975.

title: Anna K.
description: Joana suffers from a double personality and is obsessed with Anna Karenina, the character from Tolstoy's novel. Embodying the myth of Narcissus, Anna K. is the image and resemblance of Joana, stronger and more seductive.

title: K-911
description: In this sequel to the action comedy K-9, Detective Mike Dooley and his trusty canine companion Jerry Lee get two new partners - a Doberman Pincher named Zeus and his new trainer.

title: Shooting Stars
description: Oh Han Byul leads an entertainment agency's PR team. One of her top clients is star Gong Tae Sung who does no wrong. They went to the same university, where he became her sworn enemy. They bicker but soon develop feelings for one another.
